## The Right People.  The Right Room.

Since 1979, Invest Canada has convened the investors and institutions shaping Canada’s private capital markets. The conference has sold out four consecutive years because it concentrates the decision-makers active in the market into one setting for three days.


Senior partners from venture capital and private equity firms, institutional investors allocating capital, and policymakers shaping the operating environment return because this is where Canadian private market decisions are discussed directly.


Billions in private and institutional capital are moving through Canada’s markets as defence priorities shift and major project pipelines accelerate, reshaping industrial investment.


If you allocate to, raise, or deploy capital in Canada, this is the room.

### Who We Are

Our members are the investors behind the creation of thousands of jobs, the advancement of innovative technologies, and the strengthening of local economies across the country. They are the backbone of Canada’s entrepreneurial spirit, supporting businesses from startup to global expansion. CVCA proudly champions these investors, standing at their side on a mission to build a prosperous and innovative Canada.

### What We Deliver:

### Policy & Advocacy

We champion Canada’s innovation and growth ecosystems, ensuring access to vital capital, top talent, and competitive tax policies. Our policy guidance fosters an environment where private capital drives economic growth and job creation.

[Advocacy Work](https://www.cvca.ca/investing-in-canada/policy-advocacy/)

### Connection

Our approach goes beyond typical networking events. By leveraging our dynamic network that spans multiple industries and borders, we facilitate powerful partnerships and collaboration opportunities, ensuring CVCA members are always at the forefront of market developments.

[Explore Events](https://www.cvca.ca/events/)

### Research & Data

Our research and CVCA Intelligence provide critical insights and analyses, including quarterly market reports. This data empowers professionals and analysts to make informed decisions and drive economic growth.

[Explore Research](https://www.cvca.ca/insights/market-reports/)

### Essential Resources

Empower your professional growth with evolving development programs, industry model documents, and best practices. Stay informed with industry updates and navigate regulatory shifts with our insights. We aim to keep you one step ahead, freeing you to focus on your business.

[Discover Resources](https://www.cvca.ca/resources/)
